🚨 If Barcelona beat Real Madrid in El Clásico, they’ll become the FIRST team in La Liga history to win their first 10 matches of a season, breaking Real Madrid’s record of nine consecutive wins.

Barça equalled the record with today’s win over Betis. Now, they have the chance to make HISTORY against Real Madrid itself. #fcblive 🔵🔴🔥
This angle of Lamine's goal is genuine nuts. 🤯
🚨🚨 Hansi Flick: “Lamine Yamal is the BEST player in the world.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Rodri: “People usually focus on the spectacular goals, but for me, what Lamine offers is amazing and exceptional. However, I try to look at the player in a more comprehensive way. I see a player who is constantly developing and progressing in other aspects of the game, which he proves day after day.” #fcblive
🚨🎖| 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Eric García is dealing with quadriceps discomfort and will undergo tests tomorrow to check if there's a 𝐓𝐄𝐀𝐑. [@Nilsola10] #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Koundé is ALSO SUFFERING FROM SOME PROBLEMS/DISCOMFORT.” #fcblive

🚨 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Barça's defense as of now —

• Andreas Christensen - INJURED 🔴
• Eric Garcia - Quadriceps discomfort, awaiting tests. 🔴
• Gerard Martín - Knock, awaiting tests. 🔴
• Jules Koundé - Discomfort, awaiting full confirmation. 🔴

#fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on equalling La Liga’s record for the best start to a season: “It’s nice, but we have to win titles. We’re only focused on winning titles. Records are nice to have, but we need trophies.” #fcblive 🏆
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “When I subbed Lamine out, I told him that I'm very proud of him, very proud. And that he played a great game.” #fcblive 💜
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I think that today again we controlled the game well. This is how we want to play football. We scored the goals... 90 minutes running. My players did a fantastic job.” #fcblive
